newsitem.title: BERMUDA: rugby union-Waikato names team for shield match.
newsitem.headline: rugby union-Waikato names team for shield match.

text.p: There will be a reassuringly familiar look to the Waikato rugby team for Friday's Ranfurly Shield defence against Auckland.
A possible change at halfback is all that stands in the way of Waikato fielding the same team from their last shield defence against North Harbour.
Halfback Rhys Duggan, suffering from a slight rib injury, has been bracketed with Simon Crabb and a final decision may not be made until Friday.

Bruce Reihana, Aisea Tuilevu, Matthew Cooper, Wayne Warlow, Scott McLeod, Ian Foster, Rhys Duggan or Simon Crabb, Deon Muir, Duane Monkley, Mark Cooksley, Steve Gordon (captain), Scott Miller, Murray Driver, Greg Smith, Michael Collins.
Reserves: Damien Karauna, Tommy Hayes, Crabb or Duggan; Nick Holten, Tiwini Hemi, David Briggs, Richard Kirke.
